controller_sequence: Right hand grips segment 101 and lays a crossing from the uncrossed U.
Right hand grips segment 23 and raises a local arch by 15 cm.
Left hand grips segment 103 and carries the actual red terminal under the arch.
Left hand releases the terminal inside the loop, confirms the whole terminal axis is inside with at least 12 mm projected boundary clearance, then withdraws empty.

Right hand lowers the arch by 140 mm over three seconds while retaining its measured tilted orientation, checks measured support placement, releases to 24 mm, lifts vertically 30 mm over 1.5 seconds, then fully opens for one second and parks. It regrips red segment 103 from above; left hand approaches yellow segment 2 from 12 cm north, 20 mm above the measured point with a 24 mm jaw opening, then approaches horizontally and descends.

With both ends captured, right-held segment 103 lifts 65 mm and moves outward to x=0.39 m using the original 4.5 mm half-gap command. Both ends then lift and separate together over six seconds toward DOWN while ordinary gripper closure ramps smoothly to zero. The arms turn outward and pull in the same control ticks; optional half-span targets 0.57/0.58/0.59 m stop when the measured span condition passes, followed by release and retention scoring.
v4_development.independent_replay: Trials 001–019 independently score zero; demo 020 scores 1.0; matching Dream 021 scores 0.0. Both final recordings pass native closure, execution, finalization and recorded geometry checks. Dream server-session continuity is separately limited.
